Harry Stradling was the cinematographer for this film. It bears his excellent touch framing the shots. Stradling went on to win two Academy Awards for cinematography. The dark moods in "The Picture of Dorian Gray" were his idea. His second AA was for the delightful musical "My Fair Lady."
